title: Menu overhaul, part 3: cut the /for doors from 13 to 9 and merge /calm-down-fast into /mindless

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: menu overhaul picks 4A (merge the /for doors 13 to 9) and 6A (merge /calm-down-fast into /mindless); 17:23Z 'Implement all recommended options'. Strategy report: /mnt/project-files/menu-strategy-2026-11-03/REPORT.md

detail: Four /for doors fold into their nearest survivor with a 301: creators to coaches-and-healers, wellness-and-retreats to studios, markets-and-festivals to event-hosts, schools-and-programs to clubs-and-groups (kept as the survivor slug to avoid churn). The funnel registry and NICHE_DESIGN drop the four. /calm-down-fast 301s to /mindless: the route, its page-editor template, its editable-page entry, sitemap, llms files, render-path map, vitals budget and visual baselines go; the Guides link and the loneliness link point at /mindless; the member help twin becomes self-canonical. The /go/calm-down-fast campaign door stays (it already lands on /mindless). Probe: node scripts/probes/door-merges.mjs.
